title: The brief's near-miss negative for a token embedded in a longer word was implemented as a match
resolution: Coordinator decision 2026-11-03 reversed the word boundary of the pass 1 fix: a missed secret is worse than an over-redacted word, so an embedded token is redacted.

title: The fail-before run stopped at the first assertion of each test and left later behaviors unshown
resolution: The positive tests are split into one test per behavior, and verification.md records each failing against the base rule and passing with the fix.

title: The record called the pass 3 reviewer of route.json a departure from governance, which assigns the same one
resolution: The route section now names the pass 3 reviewer of route.json as the one governance assigns.

title: Format evidence named a commit but linked mutable pages without pinning or an unversioned label
resolution: E1 and E4 link the pinned github/docs commit, and the rendered page, E2, E3, and E5 are labelled unversioned.

title: The word boundary left a token after a serialized escape such as a literal \n unredacted
resolution: By coordinator decision 2026-11-03 the rule takes no left boundary, so a token is redacted wherever it starts, after an escape or inside a word, with positive tests in both users.

title: Two documents list the shapes that @taskelith/secrets redacts without the GitHub installation token
resolution: The contract sentence and a MODIFIED installation-enrollment delta name GitHub App installation tokens.

title: The record misdescribed the edited observability scenarios and the new and modified comments
resolution: verification.md names the edited scenarios and describes each new and modified comment accurately.

title: The secrets tests interpolated a string literal and duplicated the JWT literal
resolution: A module-level JWT constant serves both tests and builds the stateless token.

title: The group comment above the shape rules no longer described the GitHub rule, which took a boundary
resolution: Without its boundary the GitHub rule fits the group comment again; its own comment no longer says it is not inside a word.
